reviewedViews: All seven tiers, male and female, front/three-quarter/side/back through eight comparison sheets; both 96/160 pixel approximation sheets; all 28 icons through apparel-contact-sheet.png.
observations: All crowns remain open in authored geometry. Native hair and face are omitted and cannot be judged here.
The corrected Street neckerchief reads as a low band with one tucked end; raised bow-like ends were removed.
All coat skirts now have complete side and split rear panels.
Street and Nightblade have short hems, Wayfarer has the longest field skirt, and Masterwork adds a second shoulder fold.
Guild and Masterwork remain close members of the same family; chest layering and the second shoulder fold supply their geometric distinction.
Male and female exports show consistent material layout with independently authored torso widths; this does not establish either native body fit.
Charms have separate token, pick, rook, keys, candle and compass silhouettes.
